title: Lower bound on the Ramsey number $r(3,5)$
statement:
Let $r(k,l)$ denote the Ramsey number, the least $n$ such that every simple graph on $n$ vertices contains either a clique of size $k$ or an independent set of size $l$. Then
\[r(3,5) \ge 14.\]
replaced:
\emph{\texttt{r(3, 5) $\ge$ 14}.}

\[r(3, 5) \geq 14 \qquad (7.10)\]

with the matching upper bound (\S{}7.2, p. 114):

Now we again apply (7.7) and (7.6) to obtain
\[r(3, 5) \leq r(3, 4) + r(2, 5) = 14\]
[...] which, together with (7.10) [...] yield $r(3, 5) = 14$.
